title: Reports
subtitle: Usage, revenue and conversion trends with exportable detail.

definitions.revenue: Total revenue recorded in the selected range, before refunds.
definitions.orders: Paid orders in the range. Refunded orders stay counted.
definitions.conversion: Orders divided by sessions for the same range.
definitions.refunds: Value of refunded orders inside the range.

channels.title: Channel mix
